title: Web & API Development
description: Web application and API challenges: REST design, authentication, middleware, request handling

problems.title: JWT Authentication Middleware
problems.description: Implement JWT authentication middleware that validates tokens, extracts claims, and handles token refresh.
requirements: Validate JWT signature using RS256 or HS256
Extract and validate standard claims (exp, iat, sub)
Handle invalid/expired tokens with proper HTTP status

evaluation_criteria.security: Tokens properly validated, secrets not exposed
evaluation_criteria.error_handling: Clear error messages without leaking info

problems.title: Rate Limiter with Sliding Window
problems.description: Implement a distributed rate limiter using sliding window algorithm. Support per-user and per-endpoint limits.

problems.title: GraphQL Resolver with DataLoader
problems.description: Implement GraphQL resolvers with DataLoader pattern to solve N+1 query problem. Include pagination and filtering.

test_cases.expected: Maximum 3 database queries regardless of result count

problems.title: Webhook Delivery System
problems.description: Build a reliable webhook delivery system with retry logic, signature verification, and delivery tracking.
requirements: Dead letter queue for failed deliveries

test_cases.input: Send webhook to temporarily unavailable endpoint
test_cases.expected: Retries with backoff, eventually succeeds or moves to DLQ
